panels.title: Target leaving water
panels.description: Target of the additional zone (IR81, radiators).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensordata")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "altherma4" and r._field == "lwt_target_add")
  |> last()
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Target leaving water")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "sensordata")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "altherma4" and (r._field == "calc_q_hp_kw" or r._field == "p_el"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 15m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.calc_q_hp_kw and exists r.p_el and r.p_el > 0.1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.calc_q_hp_kw / r.p_el, _field: "COP"}))

import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Paris")
from(bucket: "sensordata")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "altherma4" and (r._field == "calc_dq_hp_kwh" or r._field == "calc_de_el_kwh"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.calc_dq_hp_kwh and exists r.calc_de_el_kwh and r.calc_de_el_kwh > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.calc_dq_hp_kwh / r.calc_de_el_kwh, _field: "SPF"}))
